NeCe,YoRK,Ntce.ioRk WITNESSETH: 10170 WHEREAS,Owner is theowner infeeofcertainland,withthebuilding and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of New York,known as Lot 1 in Block 865 on the Tax Map of the City of New York,and commonly known as 373 Fifth Avenue, New York, New York, and more particularly described on Exhibit "A" annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being herein called “Owner's Property" and said buildings and improvements, together with any future replacements thereof permitted pursuant to this Agreement, being called the “Owner's Building"); WHEREAS, Developer is the owner of certain land,with the building and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of New York,known as Lot 5 in Block 865 on the Tax Map of the City of NewYork,and commonly known as 1-3 East 35th Street, New York, New York, and more particularly described on Exhibit "B” annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being herein called “Developer's Property” and said buildings and improvements, together with any future replacements thereof WHEREAS, Developer intends to demolish the existing improvements on Developer's Property and to construct thereon a new building (such new building, as the same may be altered, modified, improved or replaced from time to time, the “New Building"); and WHEREAS,it is planned that the New Building will contain more Floor Area (as pursuant to the Zoning Resolution with the result that Developer desires to make use of the procedure available under the Zoning Resolution for combining Developer's Property and the Owner's Property into a single “zoning lot" for the purpose of making available the Excess Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) in connection with the construction of the New Building; and WHEREAS,Owner desires to allowDeveloper toutilize theExcess Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) in the New Building and, in connection therewith,to grant to Developer certain rights and easements with respect to Owner's Property as more specifically set forth herein; and WHEREAS,Owner and Developer are simultaneously herewith executing and delivering a Declaration of Restrictions, as defined in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution, in order to create a single zoning lot (the “Merged Zoning Lot") of Developer's Property, the

Owner's Property and such other parcel(s) as may be included in the Merged Zoning Lot in accordance with the terms hereof. (said Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions, as same may hereafter be modified, amended or replaced, being referred to herein as the “Declaration"); and WHEREAS, the Section 81-82 of the Zoning Resolution requires that the Merged Zoning Lot shall contain uses listed in Use Group F as set forth therein with a “floor area ratio' of not less than 1.0 (the “Minimum Retail Requirement"); and WHEREAS, the parties hereto wish to set forth certain agreements with respect to their rights and obligations in and to the Merged Zoning Lot. NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the premises contained herein and other good and valuable consideration the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the parties hereby agree as follows: Section 1.Definitions (a)“Development Rights” shall mean the rights, as determined in accordance with the thereon a structure or structures with a total floor area determined by: (i) multiplying the area of the zoning lot by the floor area ratio established for structures in the zoning district or districts in which the zoning lot is located; (i) the inclusion of any bonus floor area available to the zoning lot pursuant to the Zoning Resolution; and (i) the further inclusion of any use, bulk, density, and other development rights permitted under the Zoning Resolution and which may be authorized to be developed by the appropriate agency of the City of New York from time to time. (b)“Excess Development Rights”shall mean that portion of the total of the Development Rights now or hereafter appurtenant to Owner's Property in excess of the Utilized Development Rights, expressed in square feet. (c) “Utilized Development Rights"” shall mean the Development Rights appurtenant to Owner's Property utilized by Owner's Building as of the date of this Agreement. order, requirement, rule or regulation issued by any municipal department or other governmental authority. (e) “Zoning Resolution" shall mean the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York, effective as of December 15, 1961, as amended from time to time. Undefined terms used in this Agreement which are defined in the Zoning Resolution, including, without limitation, “floor area", “floor area ratio",“zoning lot",“parties in interest”", "use", “bulk", “"density”, “lot area” and “party in interest"’ shall have the meaning set forth in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution.
